verdict.rationale: cubic documents that developers can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription so local CLI reviews run on that provider's models. That is a choice between two providers, but it only covers local reviews. GitHub PR reviews and Ultrareview run on cubic's own models with no documented user choice. Missing for 10: model selection for GitHub PR, chat and Ultrareview sessions, specific model choice within a provider, providers beyond OpenAI and Anthropic, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose which underlying AI model powers my session from multiple providers

citations.quote: Connect your existing **ChatGPT Plus/Pro** or **Claude Code** subscription to use its models for local reviews.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push.
